function normalizeKana(s){ return s.replace(/[ァ-ヶ]/g,c=>String.fromCharCode(c.charCodeAt(0)-0x60)); }

// かな文字列を「入力単位」（拗音・撥音・促音を含む）に分解
function tokensOf(s){
 const units=[];
 for(let i=0;i<s.length;){
  let part=null;
  for(const n of [2,1]){
   const p=s.slice(i,i+n);
   if(ALIASES[p]||(n===1&&KANA_MAP[p])){part=p;break;}
  }
  if(!part) part=s[i];
  units.push(part); i+=part.length;
 }
 return units;
}

function romajiOf(u){
 return ALIASES[u]||(KANA_MAP[u]?[KANA_MAP[u]]:[u]);
}

// かな → 入力できるローマ字パターンを全部つくる（かな1文字ぶんごとの区切り位置つき）
// し→shi/si、ち→chi/ti、つ→tsu/tu、ふ→fu/hu、じ→ji/zi など。「ん」は nn（または xn）の2回打ち。
function variantsDetailed(kana){
 const units=tokensOf(normalizeKana(kana));
 let out=[{s:"",b:[]}];
 for(let k=0;k<units.length;k++){
  const u=units[k], next=units[k+1];
  let opts;
  if(u==="っ"){
   // 次の子音を重ねる（母音・な行・ん の前は重ねられない）
   const firsts=next?romajiOf(next).map(r=>r[0]).filter(c=>c&&!"aiueonyx".includes(c)):[];
   opts=firsts.length?[...new Set(firsts)]:ALIASES["っ"];
  } else if(u==="ん"){
   opts=["nn","xn"];
  } else {
   opts=romajiOf(u);
  }
  const nextOut=[];
  for(const p of out)for(const o of opts){ const str=p.s+o; nextOut.push({s:str,b:[...p.b,str.length]}); }
  out=nextOut;
 }
 const seen=new Set();
 return out.filter(d=>!seen.has(d.s)&&seen.add(d.s));
}
function variantsFor(kana){ return variantsDetailed(kana).map(d=>d.s); }
function patternsFor(word){ return variantsFor(word.kana); }

let transferring = false;

const easeInOut = t => t < .5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3) / 2;
const easeOutCubic = t => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

function makePlateEl(color){
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = "sushi-plate-real w-9 sm:w-12 h-3.5 sm:h-4";
  el.style.background = color;
  el.style.marginTop = "-6px";
  return el;
}

// 右の山の「次の1枚が置かれる場所」を示す透明な目印（常に一番上）。飛んでくる皿もクレーンもこれを基準にする
function ensureProbe(){
  const rc = $("platesRight");
  let pr = rc.querySelector(".probe");
  if(!pr){ pr = makePlateEl("transparent"); pr.classList.add("probe"); pr.style.visibility = "hidden"; rc.appendChild(pr); }
  return pr;
}

// 皿を1枚追加。rise:下から せり上がる
function pushPlate(container, color, opts = {}){
  const el = makePlateEl(color);
  container.appendChild(el);
  if(opts.rise){
    el.animate([
      { transform: "translateY(34px) scale(.9)", opacity: 0 },
      { transform: "translateY(-3px) scale(1.02,.98)", opacity: 1, offset: .7 },
      { transform: "translateY(0) scale(1)", opacity: 1 }
    ], { duration: 260, easing: "ease-out" });
  }
  return el;
}

// 単語を打ち終えたら：皿が下からせり上がって左の山に積まれる。
// クレーン側（右）が5皿未満のときだけ、左の山の一番上から右へ飛んでいく。5皿たまっている間は左にためておく
const RIGHT_MAX = 5;
let inFlight = 0, pumpTimer = 0;       // inFlight：空中を飛んでいる皿（右の枚数に数える）
function addPlate(gold){
  const color = gold ? GOLD_COLOR : PLATE_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * PLATE_COLORS.length)];
  const el = pushPlate($("platesLeft"), color, { rise: true });
  el._color = color;
  el._readyAt = performance.now() + 280;             // せり上がりを見せてから発射
  updateCounter();
  pumpLeft();
}

// 右に空きがあれば、左の山の一番上を1枚ずつ飛ばす（連打しても1枚ずつ）。空きがなければ何もしない
function pumpLeft(){
  if(pumpTimer) return;
  const left = $("platesLeft");
  const el = left.lastElementChild;
  if(!el) return;
  if(rightPlateColors.length + inFlight >= RIGHT_MAX) return;
  const token = gen, now = performance.now();
  const at = Math.max(now, nextLaunchAt, el._readyAt || 0);
  nextLaunchAt = at + 170;
  pumpTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    pumpTimer = 0;
    if(token !== gen) return;
    const top = left.lastElementChild;               // 待っている間に積まれていたら、いちばん上の皿を飛ばす
    if(!top) return;
    if(rightPlateColors.length + inFlight >= RIGHT_MAX) return;
    inFlight++;
    flyToRight(top, top._color, token);
    pumpLeft();
  }, at - now);
}

// 弧を描いて右の山へ。着地点は毎フレーム「目印」を追いかけるので、クレーンが皿を取っても着地がずれない
function flyToRight(srcEl, color, token){
  const from = srcEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const bg = srcEl.style.background;
  srcEl.remove();
  const fly = document.createElement("div");
  fly.className = "sushi-plate-real fly-plate";
  fly.style.cssText = `left:0;top:0;width:${from.width}px;height:${from.height}px;background:${bg};`;
  document.body.appendChild(fly);
  const dur = 620, t0 = performance.now();
  const lift = 58;
  function step(now){
    if(token !== gen){ fly.remove(); return; }
    const u = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (now - t0) / dur));
    const probe = $("platesRight").querySelector(".probe");
    if(!probe){ fly.remove(); inFlight = Math.max(0, inFlight - 1); return; }
    const to = probe.getBoundingClientRect();
    const e = easeInOut(u), arc = Math.sin(Math.PI * u);
    const x = from.left + (to.left - from.left) * e;
    const y = from.top + (to.top - from.top) * e - lift * arc;
    fly.style.transform = `translate(${x}px,${y}px) rotate(${-9 * arc}deg) scale(${1 + .08 * arc})`;
    if(u < 1){ requestAnimationFrame(step); return; }
    fly.remove();
    const rc = $("platesRight");
    const landed = makePlateEl(color);
    rc.insertBefore(landed, probe);
    inFlight = Math.max(0, inFlight - 1);
    rightPlateColors.push(color);
    updateRightTower();
    SFX.clink();
    landed.animate([
      { transform: "translateY(-5px) scale(1.03,.96)" },
      { transform: "translateY(1.5px) scale(.99,1.02)", offset: .55 },
      { transform: "translateY(0) scale(1)" }
    ], { duration: 280, easing: "ease-out" });
    ensureCrane();
    pumpLeft();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
}

// ================= 回転レール（画面下） =================
// 長円の周回コース。手前のレーンは右→左、奥のレーンは左→右。
// 皿は右端で置かれ → 手前を左へ → 奥を右へ（途中でにぎり機が寿司を載せる）→ また手前を左へ → 寿司付きなら出口へ
const BELT_SPEED = 110, MACHINE_FRAC = .38;
const CRANE_SINK = 6;                                            // クレーンが置くとき、レーンの皿の位置よりさらに下ろすpx（大きいほどレーンに近づく）
const isGoldColor = c => /255,\s*243,\s*176|#fff3b0/i.test(c || "");
let chefBusy = false;
const SUSHI_TOPS = ["🍣", "🍣", "🍣", "🍤", "🍙", "🍥"];
let beltItems = [], beltRaf = 0, beltLast = 0;

function beltGeom(){
  const c = $("conveyor");
  if(!c || !c.clientWidth) return null;
  const wide = c.clientWidth >= 520;
  const pw = wide ? 48 : 36, ph = wide ? 16 : 14;
  const MT = wide ? 40 : 34, Hb = wide ? 68 : 56, EW = pw + 16;
  const H = MT + Hb;
  if(c.style.height !== H + "px") c.style.height = H + "px";
  c.style.setProperty("--ew", EW + "px");
  c.style.setProperty("--mt", MT + "px");
  const Wb = c.clientWidth;
  const yF = MT + Hb * .7, yB = MT + Hb * .3, yc = MT + Hb / 2, r = (yF - yB) / 2;
  const xL = EW + pw / 2 + r + 2, xR = Wb - (pw / 2 + r + 2);
  const Lx = Math.max(20, xR - xL), half = Math.PI * r, P = 2 * Lx + 2 * half;
  return { pw, ph, MT, Hb, EW, Wb, yF, yB, yc, r, xL, xR, Lx, half, P,
           sM: Lx + half + Lx * MACHINE_FRAC,     // にぎり機の位置（奥のレーン上）
           exitS: P + Lx,                          // 2周目の手前レーンの左端 = 出口レーンへ
           exitEnd: EW - 6 - pw / 2 };             // 出口の暖簾の奥まで入ったら消す
}
function beltPos(g, s){
  if(s >= g.exitS) return { x: g.xL - (s - g.exitS), y: g.yF, exit: true };
  s %= g.P;
  if(s < g.Lx) return { x: g.xR - s, y: g.yF };
  s -= g.Lx;
  if(s < g.half){ const a = s / g.r; return { x: g.xL - g.r * Math.sin(a), y: g.yc + g.r * Math.cos(a) }; }
  s -= g.half;
  if(s < g.Lx) return { x: g.xL + s, y: g.yB };
  s -= g.Lx;
  const a = s / g.r;
  return { x: g.xR + g.r * Math.sin(a), y: g.yc - g.r * Math.cos(a) };
}
function placeBeltItem(g, it, p){
  const d = p.exit ? 1 : (p.y - g.yB) / (g.yF - g.yB);          // 0=奥 1=手前
  it.el.style.transform = `translate(${(p.x - g.pw / 2).toFixed(1)}px,${(p.y - g.ph / 2).toFixed(1)}px) scale(${(.8 + .2 * d).toFixed(3)})`;
  it.el.style.zIndex = Math.round(p.y);
  it.el.style.filter = `brightness(${(.86 + .14 * d).toFixed(2)})`;
}
function layoutBelt(g){
  const m = $("sushiMachine"), ex = $("beltExit"), rl = $("exitRail");
  m.style.left = (g.xL + g.Lx * MACHINE_FRAC) + "px";
  ex.style.cssText = `top:${g.yF - g.ph / 2 - 8}px;height:${g.ph + 16}px;width:${g.EW - 6}px;`;
  rl.style.cssText = `left:${g.EW - 6}px;width:34px;top:${g.yF + g.ph / 2 - 3}px;height:6px;`;
}
function loadSushi(it){
  it.loaded = true;
  const sp = document.createElement("span");
  sp.className = "sushi-top";
  sp.textContent = SUSHI_TOPS[Math.floor(Math.random() * SUSHI_TOPS.length)];
  it.el.appendChild(sp);
  sp.animate([
    { transform: "translate(-50%,-30px)", opacity: 0 },
    { transform: "translate(-50%,2px)", opacity: 1, offset: .75 },
    { transform: "translate(-50%,0)", opacity: 1 }
  ], { duration: 280, easing: "ease-in" });
  const m = $("sushiMachine");
  m.classList.add("on"); clearTimeout(m._t); m._t = setTimeout(() => m.classList.remove("on"), 320);
  tone(700, .05, "triangle", .03);
  chefSay();
}
function beltTick(now){
  beltRaf = 0;
  const dt = Math.min(.05, Math.max(0, (now - beltLast) / 1000)); beltLast = now;
  const g = beltGeom();
  if(g){
    layoutBelt(g);
    for(let i = beltItems.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const it = beltItems[i];
      it.s += BELT_SPEED * dt;
      if(!it.loaded && it.s >= g.sM) loadSushi(it);
      if(!it.loaded && it.s >= g.exitS) it.s -= g.P;            // 万一寿司がまだなら、もう1周
      const p = beltPos(g, it.s);
      if(p.exit && p.x <= g.exitEnd){ onBeltExit(it, g); it.el.remove(); beltItems.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      placeBeltItem(g, it, p);
    }
  }
  if(beltItems.length) beltRaf = requestAnimationFrame(beltTick);
}
function startBelt(){ if(!beltRaf){ beltLast = performance.now(); beltRaf = requestAnimationFrame(beltTick); } }
function addBeltPlate(color){
  const g = beltGeom(); if(!g) return;
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = "sushi-plate-real belt-plate";
  el.style.cssText = `position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:${g.pw}px;height:${g.ph}px;background:${color};will-change:transform;`;
  $("conveyor").appendChild(el);
  const it = { el, s: 0, loaded: false, gold: isGoldColor(color) };                       // s=0：手前レーンの右端（クレーンの置き場所）
  beltItems.push(it);
  placeBeltItem(g, it, beltPos(g, 0));
  // 置かれた直後に、ちょこんと着地（クレーンが少し下ろした分から戻る）
  el.animate([{ translate: `0 ${CRANE_SINK}px` }, { translate: "0 -2px", offset: .5 }, { translate: "0 0" }], { duration: 220, easing: "ease-out" });
  startBelt();
}
function clearBelt(){
  cancelAnimationFrame(beltRaf); beltRaf = 0;
  beltItems = [];
  document.querySelectorAll(".belt-plate").forEach(e => e.remove());
}
// クレーンの下の皿（右の山）がたまってくると、ぐらぐら揺れる（3皿〜。5皿でいちばん大きい）

// 寿司が出口から出ていくとき：暖簾が揺れて、お持ち帰りボーナス（金の皿は大きい）。時間切れ後は音だけ
function onBeltExit(it, g){
  const c = $("conveyor").getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = c.left + g.EW / 2, y = c.top + g.yF - 14;
  $("beltExit").animate([{ transform: "translateX(0)" }, { transform: "translateX(-4px)" }, { transform: "translateX(0)" }], { duration: 200, easing: "ease-out" });
  if(!running){ SFX.exit(false); return; }
  const gain = it.gold ? 30 : 5;
  score += gain;
  renderStats(); popNumber($("score"));
  floatText("+" + gain, x, y, it.gold ? "#d97706" : "#0f766e");
  if(it.gold) burst(x, y, GOLD_EMOJI, 8);
  SFX.exit(it.gold);
}

// 置き場所のまわりに、皿とクレーンの爪が入る隙間があるか（皿は絶対に重ねない）
function canDrop(g){
  const need = g.pw + 10, approach = need + BELT_SPEED * .4;    // 近づいてくる皿は、置いて爪を上げ切るまでの時間ぶん余裕を見る
  for(const it of beltItems){
    if(it.s >= g.exitS) continue;
    const d = it.s % g.P;
    if(d < need) return false;                                  // 置き場所を通り過ぎたばかりの皿
    if(g.P - d < approach) return false;                        // 置き場所へ近づいてくる皿
  }
  return true;
}

// ================= クレーン =================
// 右の山に皿が着いたら、一番上の皿を1枚ずつ掴んで、レーンの隙間に置く。皿がなくなったら待機→退場
function ensureCrane(){
  if(craneActive) return;
  craneWorker(gen, craneEpoch);
}

async function craneWorker(token, epoch){
  const g = beltGeom();
  if(!g) return;
  craneActive = true; isCraneBusy = true;

  const rightC = $("platesRight"), probe = ensureProbe();
  const W = g.pw, PH = g.ph;
  const rc = rightC.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx = rc.left + rc.width / 2;
  const cr = $("conveyor").getBoundingClientRect();
  const signEl = document.querySelector(".wooden-sign");
  const sign = signEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const railY = Math.max(6, sign.top - 28);
  let y0 = railY + 12;
  const HEAD_H = 16, GAP = 8, ARM_TOP = 9, LOAD_TOP = HEAD_H + GAP;
  const OPEN = 36, CLOSED = -3;

  const dX = cr.left + g.xR - cx;                                // レーンの置き場所までの横移動
  const dropTop = cr.top + g.yF - PH / 2;
  const Ldrop = dropTop - LOAD_TOP - y0;                         // 置く高さ
  const Lhover = Ldrop - 30;                                     // 隙間待ちの高さ（爪がレーンの皿に当たらない）

  const lerp = (a, b, u) => a + (b - a) * u;
  const clamp01 = u => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, u));
  const e = easeInOut;
  const lastLanded = () => { const c = rightC.children; for(let i = c.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if(!c[i].classList.contains("probe")) return c[i]; return null; };
  const landedCount = () => rightC.children.length - 1;
  const Lclear = () => Math.max(8, probe.getBoundingClientRect().top - 40 - LOAD_TOP - y0);   // 山の上を通る高さ
  const Lgrab = el => el.getBoundingClientRect().top - LOAD_TOP - y0;

  // ---- DOM ----
  const root = document.createElement("div");
  root.className = "crane-root";
  root.style.left = cx + "px";
  root.style.top = railY + "px";
  root.innerHTML = `
    <div class="crane-rail"></div>
    <div class="crane-hang">
      <div class="crane-trolley"></div>
      <div class="crane-swing">
        <div class="crane-cable"></div>
        <div class="crane-claw">
          <div class="crane-load"></div>
          <div class="crane-arm crane-arm-l"><i></i></div>
          <div class="crane-arm crane-arm-r"><i></i></div>
          <div class="crane-head"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  // クレーンは画面座標で動く演出なので、クリップされないようbody直下に固定。
  document.body.appendChild(root);
  /* ページ/全画面内スクロールでゲーム本体が動いた分だけ、固定クレーンも追従 */
  let lastSignTop = sign.top;
  const followGameOnScroll = () => {
    const currentTop = signEl.getBoundingClientRect().top;
    const delta = currentTop - lastSignTop;
    if(Math.abs(delta) > 0.01){
      root.style.top = (parseFloat(root.style.top || "0") + delta) + "px";
      y0 += delta;
      lastSignTop = currentTop;
    }
  };
  document.addEventListener("scroll", followGameOnScroll, true);
  const q = s => root.querySelector(s);
  const hang = q(".crane-hang"), swing = q(".crane-swing"), cable = q(".crane-cable"), claw = q(".crane-claw");
  const load = q(".crane-load"), armL = q(".crane-arm-l"), armR = q(".crane-arm-r"), head = q(".crane-head");
  q(".crane-rail").style.cssText = `left:-40px;width:${dX + 90}px;`;
  const pivot = W / 2 + 6;
  head.style.cssText = `left:${-(W / 2 + 10)}px;width:${W + 20}px;height:${HEAD_H}px;`;
  armL.style.left = (-pivot - 3) + "px";
  armR.style.left = (pivot - 3) + "px";
  armL.style.top = armR.style.top = ARM_TOP + "px";
  load.style.cssText = `left:${-W / 2}px;top:${LOAD_TOP}px;width:${W}px;height:${PH}px;display:none;`;

  // ---- 状態と描画（振り子の揺れ込み） ----
  const st = { tx: dX + 45, L: Math.min(34, Lclear()), arm: OPEN, op: 0 };
  let done = false, prevTx = st.tx, prevVx = 0, ang = 0, angV = 0, prevT = performance.now();
  const fin = () => { done = true; document.removeEventListener("scroll", followGameOnScroll, true); root.remove(); craneActive = false; isCraneBusy = false; };
  function render(now){
    if(done) return;
    if(token !== gen || epoch !== craneEpoch){ fin(); return; }
    const dt = Math.max(.001, Math.min(.05, (now - prevT) / 1000)); prevT = now;
    const vx = (st.tx - prevTx) / dt, ax = (vx - prevVx) / dt;
    prevTx = st.tx; prevVx = vx;
    const Lc = Math.max(70, st.L + 70), wn = Math.sqrt(1400 / Lc), zeta = .5;
    const force = Math.max(-4000, Math.min(4000, ax)) * .05 / Lc;
    angV += (-wn * wn * ang - 2 * zeta * wn * angV + force) * dt;
    ang = Math.max(-.12, Math.min(.12, ang + angV * dt));
    hang.style.transform = `translate3d(${st.tx}px,0,0)`;
    swing.style.transform = `rotate(${ang}rad)`;
    claw.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${st.L}px,0)`;
    cable.style.height = (st.L + 4) + "px";
    armL.style.transform = `rotate(${st.arm}deg)`;
    armR.style.transform = `rotate(${-st.arm}deg)`;
    root.style.opacity = st.op;
    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(render);

  // ---- 動作のヘルパー（false が返ったらゲームが中断された） ----
  const go = (dur, fn) => new Promise(res => {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const step = now => {
      if(token !== gen || epoch !== craneEpoch){ res(false); return; }
      const u = clamp01((now - t0) / dur);
      fn(u);
      if(u >= 1){ res(true); return; }
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  });
  const nextFrame = () => new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => r(token === gen && epoch === craneEpoch)));
  const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(token === gen && epoch === craneEpoch), ms));
  // 山より上まで上がる → 横へ → 目標の高さへ下りる
  const via = (dur, tx0, tx1, L0, L1, Lm) => {
    Lm = Math.min(Lm, L0);
    return go(dur, u => {
      st.tx = lerp(tx0, tx1, e(clamp01((u - .28) / .54)));
      st.L = u < .5 ? lerp(L0, Lm, e(clamp01(u / .38))) : lerp(Lm, L1, e(clamp01((u - .62) / .38)));
    });
  };

  // 置く瞬間の「レーンの皿の位置」を測り直す（画面がずれていても、ちゃんとレーンに届く）
  const liveDrop = () => {
    const c = $("conveyor").getBoundingClientRect(), r0 = root.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { L: c.top + g.yF - PH / 2 - LOAD_TOP - (r0.top + 12), dx: c.left + g.xR - r0.left, y: c.top + g.yF };
  };

  // ---- 入場 ----
  {
    const tx0 = st.tx, L0 = st.L, L1 = Lclear();
    if(!await go(600, u => { st.tx = lerp(tx0, 0, e(u)); st.L = lerp(L0, L1, e(u)); st.op = clamp01(u * 2.5); })) return fin();
  }

  // ---- 1枚ずつ運ぶ ----
  while(true){
    if(!lastLanded()){
      let waited = 0;                                            // 次の皿が来るのを少し待つ
      while(!lastLanded() && waited < 1800){ if(!await sleep(60)) return fin(); waited += 60; }
      if(!lastLanded()){
        const tx0 = st.tx, L0 = st.L, L1 = Lclear();
        if(!await go(450, u => { st.tx = lerp(tx0, dX + 45, e(u)); st.L = lerp(L0, L1, e(u)); st.op = 1 - u; })) return fin();
        return fin();
      }
    }
    const k = Math.max(.62, 1 - .07 * (landedCount() - 1));      // 皿がたまっているときは少し速く

    // 1. 一番上の皿まで下りる（その間に新しい皿が着いたら高さを合わせ直す）
    {
      const L0 = st.L, tg = Lgrab(lastLanded());
      if(!await go(170 * k, u => { st.L = lerp(L0, tg, e(u)); })) return fin();
      const L1 = st.L, tg2 = Lgrab(lastLanded());
      if(Math.abs(tg2 - L1) > 1.5 && !await go(70, u => { st.L = lerp(L1, tg2, e(u)); })) return fin();
    }
    // 2. 爪を閉じて掴む
    if(!await go(60 * k, u => { st.arm = lerp(OPEN, CLOSED, e(u)); })) return fin();
    const plate = lastLanded();
    const color = plate.style.background;
    plate.remove(); rightPlateColors.pop();
    updateRightTower();
    pumpLeft();                                                // 右に空きができたので、左にためた皿を1枚送る
    load.innerHTML = `<div class="sushi-plate-real" style="left:0;top:0;width:${W}px;height:${PH}px;background:${color};"></div>`;
    load.style.display = "block";

    // 3. 持ち上げて、レーンの置き場所の上へ
    if(!await via(400 * k, 0, dX, st.L, Lhover, Lclear())) return fin();

    // 4. 隙間があくまで上で待つ（皿は絶対に重ねない）
    while(!canDrop(g)) if(!await nextFrame()) return fin();

    // 5. レーンの皿の位置まで（さらに少し）下ろして、爪を開いて置く。待つ高さはそのまま
    const dd = liveDrop();
    { const L0 = st.L, tx0 = st.tx, Lend = dd.L + CRANE_SINK;
      if(!await go(180 * k, u => { st.L = lerp(L0, Lend, easeOutCubic(u)); st.tx = lerp(tx0, dd.dx, e(u)); })) return fin(); }
    load.style.display = "none";
    addBeltPlate(color);
    burst(root.getBoundingClientRect().left + dd.dx, dd.y, ["✨"], 3);
    SFX.clink();
    craneCount++;
    if(craneCount % 10 === 0) craneBonus(cx, probe.getBoundingClientRect().top);
    if(!await go(50 * k, u => { st.arm = lerp(CLOSED, OPEN, e(u)); })) return fin();

    // 6. 次の皿へ（なければ山の上へ戻る）
    {
      const nx = lastLanded(), L0 = st.L;
      const Lt = nx ? Lgrab(nx) : Lclear();
      if(!await via(260 * k, dX, 0, L0, Lt, Lclear())) return fin();
    }
  }
}

function ac(){
  if(!actx){ try{ actx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); }catch(e){} }
  if(actx && actx.state === "suspended") actx.resume();
  return actx;
}
function tone(freq, dur = .08, type = "sine", vol = .06, delay = 0, slideTo){
  if(!soundOn) return;
  const c = ac(); if(!c) return;
  const t = c.currentTime + delay;
  const o = c.createOscillator(), g = c.createGain();
  o.type = type;
  o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
  if(slideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(slideTo, t + dur);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, t + dur);
  o.connect(g); g.connect(c.destination);
  o.start(t); o.stop(t + dur + .02);
}

// 無限モードは上限なし。そのぶんゲージは多めにたまるが、時間をのばすたびに難しさがたまり、難しさが高いほどたまりにくくなる。
const CFG = {
  normal:  { gain: 10, fever: 15, gold: 10, miss: 10, bonus: 5, cap: 99 },
  sudden:  { gain: 10, fever: 15, gold: 10, miss: 10, bonus: 5, cap: 99 },
  endless: { gain: 25, fever: 35, gold: 15, miss: 10, bonus: 8, cap: Infinity }
};
let gauge = 0, gaugeLevel = 0;
let diffValue = 0;   // 無限モードの難しさ 0〜100（ゲージMAXで時間がのびるたびに増える）
const DIFF_STEP = 8;
function renderGauge(){
  $("gaugeFill").style.width = Math.min(100, gauge) + "%";
  $("timeGauge").classList.toggle("gauge-hot", gauge >= 80);
}
function resetGauge(){ gauge = 0; gaugeLevel = 0; renderGauge(); }
function addGauge(fever, gold){
  const c = CFG[mode];
  gauge += ((fever ? c.fever : c.gain) + (gold ? c.gold : 0)) * gaugeRate();
  if(gauge >= 100){ gauge -= 100; gaugeLevel++; extendTime(); }
  renderGauge();
}
function gaugeMiss(){ gauge = Math.max(0, gauge - CFG[mode].miss); renderGauge(); }

// ゲージのたまりやすさ（通常・一発勝負は最低でも半分、無限は難しさLvに応じて下がり続ける）
function gaugeRate(){
  return mode === "endless" ? Math.max(.1, 1 - .9 * diffValue / 100) : Math.max(.5, 1 - .1 * gaugeLevel);
}
function renderDiff(){
  $("diffLv").textContent = Math.round(diffValue);
  $("diffRate").textContent = "×" + gaugeRate().toFixed(2);

  diffValue = Math.min(100, diffValue + DIFF_STEP);

// 表示文字（漢字まじり）と読みを突き合わせて、漢字のかたまりごとに読みを割り当てる
const isKanjiCh=c=>/[㐀-鿿々〆]/.test(c);
function alignRuns(disp,reading){
  const runs=[];
  for(const ch of disp){
    const k=isKanjiCh(ch);
    if(runs.length&&runs[runs.length-1].k===k) runs[runs.length-1].t+=ch; else runs.push({k,t:ch});
  }
  const rd=normalizeKana(reading), res=[];
  function go(ri,p){
    if(ri===runs.length) return p===rd.length;
    const r=runs[ri];
    if(!r.k){
      const t=normalizeKana(r.t);
      if(!rd.startsWith(t,p)) return false;
      res[ri]=[p,p+t.length];
      return go(ri+1,p+t.length);
    }
    for(let e=p+1;e<=rd.length;e++){ res[ri]=[p,e]; if(go(ri+1,e)) return true; }
    return false;
  }
  return go(0,0)?runs.map((r,i)=>({k:r.k,t:r.t,a:res[i][0],b:res[i][1]})):null;
}

// u0〜u1：この文字（のかたまり）に対応する、かな入力の範囲
function mkSpan(text,u0,u1,parent){
  const sp=document.createElement("span");
  sp.className="kn";
  sp.textContent=text;
  parent.appendChild(sp);
  kanaParts.push({el:sp,u0,u1});   // かな u0〜u1-1 番目の入力に対応
  return sp;
}

function renderKana(w){
  const disp=w.disp||w.kana, reading=w.kana;
  const hasKanji=[...disp].some(isKanjiCh);
  const lens=tokensOf(normalizeKana(reading)).map(u=>u.length);   // かな1入力ぶんの文字数
  const offs=[0]; lens.forEach(n=>offs.push(offs[offs.length-1]+n));
  const el=$("kana");
  el.textContent="";
  kanaParts=[];
  const runs=alignRuns(disp,reading);
  const ok=!!runs&&runs.every(r=>offs.includes(r.a)&&offs.includes(r.b));

  if(!hasKanji){
    // かな・カナだけの語：1入力ごとに色変え（上は高さ合わせの空欄）
    const ruby=document.createElement("ruby");
    if(ok&&disp.length===reading.length) lens.forEach((n,u)=>mkSpan(disp.slice(offs[u],offs[u]+n),u,u+1,ruby));
    else ruby.appendChild(document.createTextNode(disp));
    const rt=document.createElement("rt"); rt.textContent=" ";
    ruby.appendChild(rt); el.appendChild(ruby);
    return;
  }

  if(ok){
    for(const r of runs){
      const ua=offs.indexOf(r.a), ub=offs.indexOf(r.b);
      if(!r.k){
        for(let u=ua;u<ub;u++) mkSpan(r.t.slice(offs[u]-r.a,offs[u]-r.a+lens[u]),u,u+1,el);
      } else {
        // 漢字：1文字ごとに、その文字の読みを打ち終えたら色が変わる（上のふりがなは1入力ごと）
        const chars=[...r.t];
        const split=chars.length>1?KANJI_SPLIT[r.t+"="+normalizeKana(reading).slice(r.a,r.b)]:null;
        let bounds=null;
        if(split&&split.length===chars.length){
          let pos=r.a; const bs=[];
          for(const p of split){ bs.push([pos,pos+p.length]); pos+=p.length; }
          if(pos===r.b&&bs.every(([x,y])=>offs.includes(x)&&offs.includes(y))) bounds=bs;
        }
        const groups=bounds?chars.map((ch,i)=>({t:ch,a:bounds[i][0],b:bounds[i][1]})):[{t:r.t,a:r.a,b:r.b}];
        for(const g of groups){
          const u0=offs.indexOf(g.a), u1=offs.indexOf(g.b);
          const ruby=document.createElement("ruby");
          mkSpan(g.t,u0,u1,ruby);
          const rt=document.createElement("rt"); rt.className="yomi";
          for(let u=u0;u<u1;u++) mkSpan(reading.slice(offs[u],offs[u]+lens[u]),u,u+1,rt);
          ruby.appendChild(rt); el.appendChild(ruby);
        }
      }
    }
  } else {
    // 割り当てできなかった場合は、単語全体をひとかたまりとして扱う
    const ruby=document.createElement("ruby");
    mkSpan(disp,0,lens.length,ruby);
    const rt=document.createElement("rt"); rt.className="yomi";
    lens.forEach((n,u)=>mkSpan(reading.slice(offs[u],offs[u]+n),u,u+1,rt));
    ruby.appendChild(rt); el.appendChild(ruby);
  }
}

// 打ったローマ字の文字数に比例して、各文字を左から塗っていく
function updateKanaProgress(d,t){
  const bs=d.b;
  kanaParts.forEach(p=>{
    const start=p.u0===0?0:bs[p.u0-1], end=bs[p.u1-1];
    let f=end>start?(t-start)/(end-start):0;
    f=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,f));
    p.el.style.setProperty("--p",(f*100).toFixed(1)+"%");
    p.el.classList.toggle("done",f>=1);
  });
}

  if(sc > 1200) return "🍱 大将クラス";
  if(sc > 700) return "🍤 一人前職人";
  if(sc > 300) return "🍵 見習い職人";
  return "🥚 ひよこ職人";
}

function finishGame(reason){
  if(!running) return;
  running=false;
  clearInterval(timer);
  renderStats();
  SFX.end();
  if(reason==="miss") bigText("MISS!",{color:"#b91c1c",size:"min(110px,22vw)",top:"40%",sub:"一発勝負 終了…",hold:800});
  else if(mode==="sudden") bigText("NO MISS!",{color:"#047857",size:"min(110px,22vw)",top:"40%",sub:"ノーミスで走りきった！",hold:800});
  else bigText("TIME UP!",{color:"#b91c1c",size:"min(110px,22vw)",top:"40%",hold:800});
  const token=gen;

  setTimeout(()=>{
    if(token!==gen) return;
    // お皿・クレーン・レールは止めない（残りの皿もそのまま流れていく）
    $("game").classList.add("result-mode");   // ゲーム画面は見せたまま、結果画面を上に重ねる
    $("result").classList.remove("hidden");

    $("finalScore").textContent=score;
    $("finalMiss").textContent=miss;
    $("finalCombo").textContent=maxCombo;
    $("finalCount").textContent=completed;
    $("rankTitle").textContent=getRank(score);

    // ベストスコア（このブラウザに保存）
    const key=(mode==="normal"?"sushiBest_":"sushiBest_"+mode+"_")+selected;
    const label=(mode==="normal"?"":modeNames[mode]+" ")+levelNames[selected]+"コース";
    $("resultTitle").textContent=mode==="sudden"?(reason==="miss"?"ミスで終了！":"ノーミスクリア！！"):"おつかれさまでした！";
    let best=0;
    try{ best=+localStorage.getItem(key)||0; }catch(e){}
    const isNew=score>best&&score>0;
    if(isNew){ try{ localStorage.setItem(key,String(score)); }catch(e){} }
    $("recordInfo").textContent=(isNew
      ? `🎉 NEW RECORD！（${label} ベスト更新）`
      : `${label} ベスト: ${best}`)+(mode==="endless"?` ／ 難しさ ${Math.round(diffValue)}% まで到達`:"");

    celebrate(score,isNew);
  },1300);
}

  fitPrompt();
}

// 長い単語でも折り返さず、枠の幅に収まるまで文字サイズを自動で小さくする
function fitEl(el,max,min,avail){
  let size=max;
  el.style.fontSize=size+"px";
  while(size>min && el.scrollWidth>avail){ size--; el.style.fontSize=size+"px"; }
}
function fitPrompt(){
  const pb=$("promptBox");
  if(!pb||!pb.offsetWidth) return;
  const cs=getComputedStyle(pb);
  const avail=pb.clientWidth-parseFloat(cs.paddingLeft)-parseFloat(cs.paddingRight)-2;
  if(avail<=0) return;
  const wide=pb.clientWidth >= 500;
  fitEl($("kana"),wide?48:30,13,avail);
  fitEl($("romajiBox"),wide?30:20,10,avail);
}

/* 通常表示は850pxのプレイヤー枠内でゲームだけを小さく中央配置。全画面も中央に配置 */
function fitGameStage(){
  const app=$("game-app"), stage=$("game-stage");
  if(!app||!stage) return;
  const baseWidth=850;
  const available=Math.max(1,app.clientWidth);
  const fullscreen=!!(document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement);
  const widthScale=available/baseWidth;
  const heightScale=fullscreen ? Math.max(.35,(window.innerHeight-110)/Math.max(1,stage.offsetHeight)) : 1;
  const scale=Math.min(widthScale,1,heightScale);
  const offset=Math.max(0,(available-baseWidth*scale)/2);
  stage.style.transform="translateX("+offset+"px) scale("+scale+")";
  app.style.height=(stage.offsetHeight*scale+(fullscreen?58:52))+"px";
}

function processKey(key){
  if(!running||!current) return;

  if(key==="Backspace"){
    typed=typed.slice(0,-1);
    updateTypingView();
    return;
  }

  if(!/^[a-z-]$/i.test(key)) return;

  const candidate=(typed+key.toLowerCase());

  if(accepted.some(v=>v.startsWith(candidate))){
    typed=candidate;
    updateTypingView();
    SFX.key();

    if(accepted.includes(typed)){
      const fever=combo>=10;
      const gold=Math.random()<.1;
      let gain=10+Math.min(combo,20);
      if(fever) gain*=2;
      if(gold) gain+=50;
      score+=gain;
      combo++;
      maxCombo=Math.max(maxCombo,combo);
      completed++;
      addGauge(fever,gold);

      wordFx(gain,gold,fever);
      addPlate(gold);
      renderStats();
      popNumber($("score"));
      popNumber($("combo"));
      if(MILESTONES[combo]) comboMilestone(combo);
      nextWord();
    }
  } else {
    const wasFever=combo>=10;
    miss++;
    combo=0;
    renderStats();
    gaugeMiss();
    missFx(wasFever);
    if(mode==="sudden") finishGame("miss");   // 一発勝負：1ミスで即終了
  }
}

    processKey("Backspace");
  } else if(e.key.length===1){
    e.preventDefault();
    processKey(e.key);
  }
});

(()=>{
  const button=document.getElementById("fullscreenButton");
  const target=document.querySelector(".center");

    const active=document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement;

    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    try{
      const active=document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement;
      if(active){
        if(document.exitFullscreen) await document.exitFullscreen();
        else if(document.webkitExitFullscreen) document.webkitExitFullscreen();
        else throw new Error("fullscreen exit unavailable");
        return;
      }
      if(target.requestFullscreen) await target.requestFullscreen({navigationUI:"hide"});
      else if(target.webkitRequestFullscreen) target.webkitRequestFullscreen();
      else {

        if(game && game.requestFullscreen) await game.requestFullscreen();
        else if(game && game.webkitRequestFullscreen) game.webkitRequestFullscreen();
        else throw new Error("fullscreen unavailable");
      }
    }catch(error){
      button.textContent="全画面にできません";
      setTimeout(refresh,2200);
    }
  });
  document.addEventListener("fullscreenchange",()=>{refresh();requestAnimationFrame(()=>{if(window.fitGameStage) window.fitGameStage();});});
  document.addEventListener("webkitfullscreenchange",()=>{refresh();requestAnimationFrame(()=>{if(window.fitGameStage) window.fitGameStage();});});

})();
